title: Sources: Anthropic told investors that distillation accounts for 5% to 7% of its revenue; its rapid but slowing revenue growth could weigh on its IPO valuation (Cory Weinberg/The Information)
summary: Cory Weinberg / The Information: Sources: Anthropic told investors that distillation accounts for 5% to 7% of its revenue; its rapid but slowing revenue growth could weigh on its IPO valuation — Anthropic reported rapid-but-slowing revenue growth in a meeting with potential investors in its planned initial public offering …
